Composer

According to the “Fiddler’s Companion” website, this jig was composed by John McGrath, a Co. Mayo fiddler who lived in America, and whom I think is also credited with composing “The Providence” reel.

↳ Posted by Kenny on October 23rd, 2004.

I changed the name “my” Brides’s Favourite to “Trancey’s fancy”.
